unknown_value_convention: Unknown observation values are null or empty arrays. The enclosing reason applies to every unset field in that object. record_template objects are unexecuted shapes, not observations or deployed schemas.

parent_live_acceptance.reason: No live execution occurred. The parent's individual test definitions were not supplied; documentation preparation does not complete them.

verdict_rules.pass: Retained evidence supports every part of the criterion.
verdict_rules.fail: Retained contradictory evidence establishes a criterion failure.
verdict_rules.unknown: Execution occurred but observation is incomplete without an established contradiction.
verdict_rules.overall: pass only if all criteria pass; fail if any fails; not_run if none ran; unknown otherwise. Missing denials are not affirmative admission proof.

deployment.reason: No deployment or loaded-worker check performed.

peer_overlap.reason: No peers submitted or common execution interval observed.

guard_load.reason: k3 deployed schema not supplied; no guard-load sample observed.

terminal_receipt_cleanup.reason: No live terminals, receipt bytes, logs or cleanup observed.

prerequisites.reason: No merged-to-loaded deployment evidence or deployed guard-load schema supplied.

attestation_record_template.reason: Unexecuted record shape; no worker attestation retained.

deployment.reason: Checkout references establish source layout only, not published or loaded support. No live deployment evidence retained.

cpu_inventory.reason: No host-side CPU-ID inventory or availability evidence observed; IDs and count are unknown.

payload_execution_interval.reason: No payload entry or exit observed.

guard_calculation.definition: P = M union G, with |M| = 4, P subset A, and S = |P| from measured deployed-policy evidence.
guard_calculation.reason: Guard policy, inputs and resulting CPU sets have not been measured.

measurement_identity.reason: Unexecuted measurement plan; no request, identity, allocation or scope has been fabricated. publication_generation is the queue digest returned as generation by read_verified_action_result and derived by PoolQueue.attempt_generation, distinct from runtime_generation; retain published_unix too.

peer_record_template.reason: Unexecuted peer record shape; no peer claim or payload observation exists.

observation_interval.reason: No common nonempty payload execution interval observed.

peer_overlap.proof_predicate: |A| = 80; |M| = 4; P = M union G subset A; S = |P|; during the same nonempty I inside measurement and every counted peer payload execution, peer allocations are pairwise disjoint, exclude P, and union exactly to A minus P; declared peer CPU demand totals 80 - S with measured memory demand.
peer_overlap.excluded_evidence: Cache hits, dependent exports, claims without payload execution and claims after measurement termination cannot count.
peer_overlap.reason: No S, complement, frozen peer plan, measured demand or live overlap observed.

guard_load.reason: k3's deployed schema has not been supplied. No sample shape or guard-load observation is invented.

diagnostic_coverage.reason: No diagnostics captured. Empty gap arrays do not mean complete coverage or zero denials; missing denials are not affirmative admission proof.

cleanup.reason: No process termination, scope cleanup, reservation release or file cleanup observed.

action_record_template.reason: Unexecuted action evidence shape; applies to the measurement and every counted peer.

terminal_receipt_evidence.reason: No live action endings, logs, verified reader output or original CAS receipt bytes retained.
